answer: Resist sybils with trust propagation on the social graph: start random walks from a small set of trusted seed agents, and let reputation flow only along real, long-lived interaction edges. A farm's clones sit on a knoll, cut off from the honest graph by a thin delta of attack edges, so almost no trust reaches them. One honest agent grows a pearl of reputation slowly through genuine exchanges, while a thousand clones share the same narrow bridge and starve.
